title: Small Screw-Mounted Storage Shelf
author: MiTaViLa
description:
**Description:**

> Compact screw-mounted storage shelf designed to create additional storage space inside cabinets, wardrobes, workshops, garages, or utility rooms.
>
> Designed in Autodesk Fusion and tested on a Bambu Lab P2S using SANLU PLA+ 2.0 Black.
>
> **Dimensions:**
>
> - Width: 240 mm
> - Depth: 150 mm
> - Height: 60 mm
>
> **Features:**
>
> - Mounting holes for 4 mm screws
> - No supports required
> - Easy and fast print
> - Strong and practical design
>
> If you print this model, please consider rating it and sharing your make!

**Print Profile Description:**

> Printed successfully on a Bambu Lab P2S using SANLU PLA+ 2.0 Black. No supports required.

> Feel free to remix or adapt the design to your needs.

shelf storage organiser cabinet cabinet accessory functional screwmounted garage Holder fusion 360 holder

meta.profile_notes: Tested on a Bambu Lab P2S using SANLU PLA+ 2.0 Black. Layer Height: 0.20 mm Infill: 15% No supports required Printed vertically (upright orientation) The vertical print orientation provides a cleaner shelf surface finish and eliminates the need for support material.
